_about: Map projections that don't line up with the game's coordinates, fitted by overlapping our navmesh's walkable floor with tarkov.dev's map images (best IoU). 'offset' shifts one floor's image by [dx, dy] zoom-0 pixels so it lines up with the corrected projection. 'height' replaces a floor's height band where tarkov.dev's (set for marker heights) cuts through the real floor.

icebreaker.note: tarkov.dev's [2, 125, 3.5, 91] drew the ship 1.3x too wide and 2.6x too long for its images (the Helicopter extract and stern spawns fell off the map) and its bounds were Factory's, so bow and stern tiles never loaded. The deck images are drawn at a slight tilt: each deck's image sits 0.45 px further down per metre of height, so every deck gets the offset its own image fits best (IoU 0.3-0.55, deck matched to navmesh heights 9-46 m). Deck height bands are re-cut around the navmesh's deck heights (9.5, 13, 15.9, 18.5 main, 21.2, 23.8, 26.5, 29.3, 32, 34.6, 37.3, 40, 43.3 m): tarkov.dev's sat about 1 m high, so e.g. the bridge floor (40 m) fell under its 40.7 m band.
